# KapanLagi.com

> > KapanLagi.com is Indonesia's leading entertainment portal covering celebrity news, K-pop, Indonesian cinema, lifestyle, and digital content across multiple cities.

Part of KapanLagi Youniverse under EMTEK Group, KapanLagi.com serves as a comprehensive multimedia platform delivering entertainment news, film reviews, fashion trends, and cultural content. The site hosts major events including KapanLagi Buka Bareng Festival, Kapanlagi Korean Festival, and KapanLagi Goyang Amal across Jakarta, Yogyakarta, and Malang.
